استحقرن (form X)
# اِسْتَحْقَرْنَ (istaḥqarna) /is.taħ.qar.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَحْقَرَ (istaḥqara)
# اُسْتُحْقِرْنَ (ustuḥqirna) /us.tuħ.qir.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَحْقَرَ (istaḥqara)
# اِسْتَحْقِرْنَ (istaḥqirna) /is.taħ.qir.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَحْقَرَ (istaḥqara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
